facts.text: Thomas University fields a Military Transition Football program composed of veterans, guards, and reserves to help them transition to civilian life.

sources.title: Thomas University Ranked No. 1 Military Friendly School - Thomas ...
sources.quote: TU concluded its inaugural season of the Military Transition Football program, which consists of individuals with military affiliations like veterans, guards, and reserves. The program is designed to help individuals transition from military life back to civilian life.
